findings.title: Production handoff must mandatorily inherit RA-CE-1 and RA-CE-7 as acceptance tests
findings.detail: v4 correctly demotes the broken v3 runner but does not bind future detailed design to re-fail those exact semantic holes. openDecisions says design the production contract later without requiring the counterexamples as gates. Without that, a new wire contract can reintroduce zero-eval pass and outcome-blind pass under a green schema checker (Error-6 recurrence).
findings.requiredFix: Add to detailedDesignHandoff or openDecisions: any production evidence contract is incomplete until executable tests fail RA-CE-1 and RA-CE-7 attempts (and preferably RA-CE-2..6). Prefer second-author goldens.

findings.title: Feasibility of privacy-acceptable authoritative no-match remains load-bearing and unproved
findings.detail: Author confidence correctly medium. Architecture can require it (RA-1/RA-2) while product still cannot ship if no construction stays below source-archive cost. This is not a reason to reject v4; it is a seal and product gate.
findings.requiredFix: Keep openDecisions measurement/demo items as seal blockers; do not mark ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS sealed until one representative construction exists (even if experimental).

findings.title: Zero-implicit-retention is correctly candidate product posture, not free architecture
findings.detail: defaultPosture is right for the threat model. Product may still want a documented short retention with first-run consent. openCoordinatorDecision already flags this.
findings.requiredFix: Coordinator/product disposition recorded before treating defaultPosture as sealed product behavior.
